intro: Master the mystic arts—match arcane orbs and save the kingdom from the surge!
description:
Step into a realm of high fantasy where a legendary wizard’s apprentice wields arcane orbs with the flick of a wand! Choose your stage, aim your magic-infused spheres at winding stone paths, and match three or more identical elements to trigger spectacular spells before they invade your inner sanctum. Achieve legendary scores and earn three mystical stars per level by dispelling waves with magical precision.
Between your quests, spend your earned mana-gold to unlock ancient wizardly upgrades:
Dragon’s Breath: Scorches clusters with a torrential blast of fire.
Chronos Shift: Freezes the flow of orbs in their tracks.
Alchemy Orb: Transmutes your next sphere into any element you desire.
Starfall Barrage: Calls down a rain of meteors to clear the path.
Arcane Bolt: Shatters a single, stubborn orb with concentrated energy.
Rewind Rune: Reverses the stream, granting you a second chance at a perfect match.
Journey through four enchanting realms—the Whispering Elf-Woods, the Floating Sky-Castles, the Frost-Giant Peaks, and the Shadow-Dragon’s Lair. Every ten levels, the magic shifts to reveal new paths, rarer orb colors, magical barriers, and intensifying speeds.
Addictive and easy to learn yet challenging to master, this epic adventure delivers spellbinding arcade fun for wizards and warriors of all ages.
